title: Mayhem, Mystique, & Murder in Myrtle Beach Ghost Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Embark on an unforgettable journey through the eerie streets of Myrtle Beach with our captivating walking ghost tour!

Led by an expert local guide, you'll hear chilling tales of ghostly encounters and lingering spirits that haunt iconic buildings.

As you stroll through the historic district, your guide will share fascinating stories of tormented souls that still roam the area, blending entertainment and education in a way that will leave you intrigued. The tour covers a mile of haunted real estate, including notorious sites like Peaches Corner and the Bowery, each steeped in mystery and history. The Myrtle Beach Boardwalk and Plyler Park serve as eerie backdrops for tales of love, loss, and lingering spirits.

While entry into private buildings isn't included, you'll stand on ground rich with ghostly lore, making each step a brush with the supernatural.

Join us for an evening filled with ghostly encounters that will haunt your memories long after the tour ends!
